description: Full-text search across the vault. Returns ranked excerpts (~120 chars, tunable) — not full notes — to minimise context usage. Supports fuzzy matching and prefix search; with SEEKSTONE_SEMANTIC=1, mode "semantic"/"hybrid" searches by meaning via a local embedding model.

excerptLength.description: Max characters of match context per hit (20–2000, default 120).

folder.description: Restrict to a vault-relative folder prefix.

mode.description: lexical = keyword search (default). semantic = meaning-based search (requires SEEKSTONE_SEMANTIC=1). hybrid = exact-title lookups go lexical, everything else semantic.

tag.description: Restrict to notes with this tag. # optional, case-insensitive; nested child tags match ("project" matches project/alpha).

name: search
